title: Wall Mount paper towel holder 15-Inch Solid Brass Retro Wave Collection, Traditional Style Allied Brass
description:
Keep your countertop clean and clutter-free with this wall mount paper towel holder, crafted from solid brass. From the retro wave collection, it delivers a traditional, elegant look and coordinates easily with matching retro wave accessories for a unified space.

Highlights:
- Space-saving wall-mounted paper towel holder for kitchen organization
- Solid brass construction
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean appearance
- Available in multiple designer finishes to coordinate with traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories
- Installation hardware included

Specs:
- Overall size: 15 in height x 4 in length x 2.25 in width
- Projection: 5 in
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Paper towel holder and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
